verdict.rationale: uv documents one import path: migrating from a requirements.txt file with `uv add -r` (uv-docs-42). It also offers a drop-in `uv pip` interface for pip and pip-tools users who are not ready to fully transition (uv-docs-5, uv-docs-31). Although uv positions itself as replacing poetry and others (uv-docs-4), and a user reports moving off pyenv+poetry (uv-comm-2), the evidence shows no documented conversion tooling for poetry, pipenv, or pip-tools lockfiles, and one user reports uv is unforgiving with legacy setups during onboarding (uv-comm-16). missing for 10: documented importers for poetry/pipenv/pip-tools projects and lockfiles, an in-depth migration guide, independent hands-on corroboration of the conversion workflow.
